scope: Linux x64 child-process lifetime corrections; targeted native comparisons and unchanged upstream regressions, not complete Lean/OS/engine parity.
causes: Node ChildProcess.kill silently returns false after exit; the host lost native ESRCH after Lean wait or tryWait.
The process-group branch exposed signed libuv errno/text where native Lean uses positive POSIX errno/libc text.
A dropped Child retained a referenced Node process handle and could keep an otherwise finished host running.
fixes: Return native ESRCH after a non-group child has been reaped.
Map POSIX process-group kill errors through native errno; retain group termination when surviving members outlive their reaped leader.
Unreference a dropped child without killing it. Its exit listener still reaps it while the parent remains alive.
